question: A certain number of people are sitting in a row, facing North. S sits third to the left of Q. T sits fourth to the right of R. Only three persons sit between R and Q. Only two persons sit between P and R. If no other person is sitting in the row, what is the total number of persons seated?
solution:
Given:

A certain number of people are sitting in a row, facing North.

1) T sits fourth to the right of R.

2) Only three persons sit between R and Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc41a52ddac0b4ac6c3dcda414244de13ecc2e79a0230bccad84d01a8178130f.png] 

3) S sits third to the left of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b5cdd01a96ca8347294ecca852f58f7be2f9bb5b12580a8f6baedd95aa8a668.png] 

4) Only two persons sit between P and R.

**Case I:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b5599a3274e2010cdde9aa76d37c70bbb66aeeeccebedb4e0e327a054b06e68e.png] 

**Case II:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d07d3be63dc75a20da43958a053fbd349747a5e41a0e3b4abadaa0815f25f9bc.png] 

In both case total 12 people are sitting in the row.

Hence, Total **"12"** people are sitting in the row.
